# Wren conformance

**Generated by `cargo run -p wren --example conformance`. Do not edit by hand** —
every row is a program that was just run, and its status is what actually
happened. A table maintained by editing drifts the first time somebody fixes
something and forgets the doc.

The chapters follow Wren's own documentation — `vendor/wren/doc/site/*.markdown`,
published at <https://wren.io> — so a `missing` row points at a specific
paragraph of the spec rather than at a vague gap.

|---|---|

| **works** | **80** |
| differs | 2 |
| missing | 14 |
